fact: The party arrives at a natural cave containing dancing fungal creatures.
source_quote: They arrived at a natural cave
subject: Natural Cave

fact: Several Myconids are dancing in a frantic, crazed manner that is unnatural for their kind.
source_quote: Several Myconids were dancing in a frantic, crazed manner that Daz recognized as completely unnatural for their kind.
subject: Dancing Myconids

fact: Three Myconids stand five feet tall.
subject: Large Myconids

fact: The remaining Myconids are half the height of the larger ones.
subject: Small Myconids

fact: One small Myconid stands apart from the group and moves with far less frantic energy.
source_quote: one of the small ones stood apart with far less frantic movements
subject: Calm Small Myconid

fact: Two large, ape-like creatures covered in yellow mold and mushroom growths are hunched near the dancing Myconids.
source_quote: Two large, ape-like creatures covered in yellow mold and mushroom growths were hunched nearby
subject: Mold-Covered Ape Creatures

fact: Sarith became agitated and attempted to run toward the dancing Myconids when they came into view.
source_quote: Sarith, the drow emissary traveling with the party, became agitated the moment the dancing Myconids came into view.
subject: Sarith

fact: Sarith wanted to join the Myconids in their dance.
subject: Sarith

fact: Zalthir grappled Sarith and hauled him back around the corner to prevent him from joining the dancing Myconids.
source_quote: Zalthir, an expert grappler, reacted quickly, grabbed him, and hauled him back around the corner.
subject: Sarith Grapple

fact: Gyrgum has a passive perception of 14.
source_quote: Gyrgum, with a passive perception of 14
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum noticed that Sarith grew more agitated the instant he had line of sight to the Myconids.
source_quote: Gyrgum's passive perception caught that the agitation began the instant Sarith had line of sight.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz noted that the effects reaching the party extend beyond 30 feet.
source_quote: Daz notes that effects are clearly reaching beyond 30 feet
subject: Daz

fact: Rumpadump appeared calm and studious while the other Myconids danced frantically.
source_quote: It was then that Rumpadump appeared, calm and studious where the others were frantic
subject: Rumpadump Appearance

fact: Stool spotted Rumpadump and moved excitedly to meet him.
source_quote: Stool spots Rumpadump... and moves excitedly to meet him.
subject: Stool

fact: Stool erupted with excitement upon seeing Rumpadump.
source_quote: Stool erupted with excitement at the reunion ("I found you. I found you. I found you.").
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump stated that something is not right.
source_quote: Rumpadump said simply: "something is not right here."
subject: Rumpadump

fact: The other Myconids ignored both the party and Stool's movements.
source_quote: The other Myconids ignore both the party and Stool's bouncing.
subject: Myconid Indifference
